verdict.rationale: Brave's single API covers each step of the story. The LLM Context endpoint returns pre-extracted, token-budgeted page content for agents with "no scraping". The Answers endpoint synthesizes grounded answers and has an explicit research mode for "iterative deep research instead of a single search". The official MCP server exposes web search, LLM context and summarization as agent tools. Missing for 10: an endpoint to extract contents from arbitrary user-supplied URLs (extraction is tied to search results), inline citations in research mode (documented as unsupported), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end research flow.
